description: Scaffold the isolated Strapi 5 app under cms/ with exact-pinned dependencies (design §2, §7), the TypeScript + vitest/nock test harness, and build isolation so `npm ci`/`npm install`, `npm run build`, and `npm run test` all run green while the Go module stays untouched. This is the foundation every later feature builds on; it depends on nothing. Independent of FEAT-002..004 only in that they build ON it.
steps: Scaffold a Strapi 5 TypeScript app in-place at /home/nuzirwan/project/rule-engine-api/.worktrees/strapi-cms/cms (use the official generator, e.g. `npx create-strapi-app@5.56.0 cms --typescript --skip-cloud --no-run --use-npm` from the worktree root; if the generator refuses a non-empty dir, scaffold in a temp dir and move it into cms/). The app MUST live wholly under cms/ — never add Node files under the Go internal/ or cmd/ trees.

Pin EVERY dependency to an exact version (no ^/~) in cms/package.json per design §7: dependencies @strapi/strapi 5.56.0, @strapi/design-system 2.2.4, @strapi/icons 2.2.4, @gorules/jdm-editor 1.52.0, reactflow 11.11.4, react 18.3.1, react-dom 18.3.1, react-router-dom 6.30.3, styled-components 6.1.13, pg 8.13.1, zod 3.24.2; devDependencies @strapi/sdk-plugin 6.1.1, vitest 2.1.8, nock 13.5.6. Set engines.node = "22.x". BEFORE pinning, verify each exact version still resolves on npm at build time (`npm view <pkg>@<version> version`); if a pin no longer exists, record the discrepancy in findings and pick the nearest existing patch, noting it. Add scripts: `build` (strapi build), `develop`, `start`, and `test` = `vitest run`.

Add cms/.npmrc with `save-exact=true` and `engine-strict=false` (so engines.node=22.x does not fail install on the local Node 20.19.1 — EBADENGINE stays a warning per context.json). Add cms/.nvmrc with `22.11.0`.

Add cms/.gitignore ignoring node_modules/, build/, dist/, .cache/, .strapi/, .tmp/, and *.log. (The repo-root .gitignore already covers .env and .env.*.) Add cms/.env.example documenting ADMIN_API_BASE_URL, ADMIN_API_OPERATOR_TOKEN, ADMIN_API_ENV (payloadEnv, default ""), and Strapi DB_* vars, plus a note that the operator token's engine-side subject must be granted flow.read+flow.write+flow.publish (design §3.4, §5.6). This is the CMS env file — distinct from the Go engine's root .env.example.

Add a vitest config (cms/vitest.config.ts) scoped to the plugin test dir, and a tsconfig that compiles the server services. Add ONE trivial placeholder test under cms/src/plugins/rule-engine/server/tests/ (e.g. sanity.test.ts asserting true) so `npm run test` has something to run green before FEAT-003 adds the real suite.

Create the empty plugin skeleton directory tree from design §2 (src/plugins/rule-engine/{admin/src,server/src/{services,controllers,lifecycles,routes}}, types/) so later features drop files into a known layout. Register the local plugin in cms/config/plugins.ts.
Run the install, Strapi build, and the placeholder test; then from the worktree root confirm the Go module still builds.
acceptance_criteria: cms/package.json lists every dependency from design §7 at an EXACT version (no ^/~) and engines.node="22.x"; cms/package-lock.json exists and is committed.
`npm install` (first run) then `npm ci` succeed in cms/ on the local Node 20.19.1 without a fatal engine error (EBADENGINE is a non-fatal warning).
`npm run build` succeeds in cms/ (Strapi build completes).
`npm run test` runs green (the placeholder test passes) in cms/.
cms/.gitignore excludes node_modules/build/dist/.cache/.strapi; cms/node_modules and build output are NOT staged for commit.
No change to go.mod, go.sum, or any file under the Go internal/ or cmd/ trees; no Node files under those trees.
verification: cd /home/nuzirwan/project/rule-engine-api/.worktrees/strapi-cms/cms && npm install && npm ci  (both succeed; lockfile present after first install)
cd /home/nuzirwan/project/rule-engine-api/.worktrees/strapi-cms/cms && npm run test  (vitest run exits 0, placeholder passes)
cd /home/nuzirwan/project/rule-engine-api/.worktrees/strapi-cms && CGO_ENABLED=1 go build ./...  (exit 0 — Go untouched)
cd /home/nuzirwan/project/rule-engine-api/.worktrees/strapi-cms && git status --porcelain -- go.mod go.sum internal cmd  (empty — no Go-tree changes)
findings:
DONE. Scaffold landed under cms/ via `npx create-strapi-app@5.56.0 cms --typescript --skip-cloud --no-run --use-npm --no-example --no-git-init --dbclient=sqlite` from the worktree root (dir was non-existent, so no temp-dir move needed). Then rewrote package.json to exact pins.

DEP PINS: all 14 design-§7 pins resolved EXACTLY on npm at build time — NO discrepancies, no substitutions. Resolved top-level versions (from committed package-lock.json): deps @strapi/strapi 5.56.0, @strapi/design-system 2.2.4, @strapi/icons 2.2.4, @gorules/jdm-editor 1.52.0, reactflow 11.11.4, react 18.3.1, react-dom 18.3.1, react-router-dom 6.30.3, styled-components 6.1.13, pg 8.13.1, zod 3.24.2; dev @strapi/sdk-plugin 6.1.1, vitest 2.1.8, nock 13.5.6. engines.node="22.x".

GENERATOR EXTRAS (not in §7, decided): kept @strapi/database@5.56.0 (config/database.ts imports isDatabaseClientKind) and @strapi/plugin-users-permissions@5.56.0 (config/plugins.ts configures it) — both pinned exact. DROPPED the generator's better-sqlite3 and @strapi/plugin-cloud (Postgres is the committed default, no cloud). Pinned the generator's loose TS tooling to exact resolvable versions: typescript 5.5.3, @types/node 20.14.10, @types/react 18.3.3, @types/react-dom 18.3.0 (all verified on npm).

DATABASE (user requirement applied): config/database.ts defaults DATABASE_CLIENT=postgres (sqlite is local opt-in only). CMS uses its OWN db + OWN schema, SEPARATE from the engine config store (which the CMS reaches only via the admin HTTP API). Env-driven with a CMS_DB_* prefix so it can never collide with the engine's DB_*: CMS_DB_HOST, CMS_DB_PORT(5432), CMS_DB_NAME(default strapi_cms), CMS_DB_USER(strapi_cms), CMS_DB_PASSWORD, CMS_DB_SSL(false), CMS_DB_SCHEMA(default strapi_cms — NEVER public, NEVER the engine's rule_engine), CMS_DB_POOL_MIN/MAX. postgres connection sets `schema: env('CMS_DB_SCHEMA','strapi_cms')`. All documented in cms/.env.example with a comment that this DB/schema is separate from the engine config store.

ISOLATION/ENGINES: cms/.npmrc has save-exact=true + engine-strict=false, so engines.node=22.x emits only a non-fatal EBADENGINE warning on local Node v20.19.1 — install/build/test all exit 0. cms/.nvmrc=22.11.0.

GITIGNORE QUIRK (later features note this): the repo-root .gitignore rule `.env.*` also matches cms/.env.example, so a committed CMS env template is swallowed unless re-included. cms/.gitignore ends with `!.env.example` to un-ignore just the template while cms/.env stays ignored. cms/.gitignore also explicitly ignores node_modules/ build/ dist/ .cache/ .strapi/ .tmp/ *.log.

PLUGIN SKELETON: src/plugins/rule-engine/{admin/src, server/src/{services,controllers,lifecycles,routes}, server/tests}, plus top-level types/. All empty dirs carry a .gitkeep. The local plugin IS registered in config/plugins.ts as `'rule-engine': { enabled: false, resolve: './src/plugins/rule-engine' }` — kept DISABLED because the skeleton has no entry (index.ts) files yet; FEAT-002+ must flip enabled:true once admin/server code exists, otherwise Strapi fails to load an entry-less plugin.

TEST HARNESS: cms/vitest.config.ts (environment node, globals, include scoped to src/plugins/rule-engine/server/tests/**/*.{test,spec}.ts). cms/tsconfig.server.json extends tsconfig.json to compile the plugin server services. Placeholder test: src/plugins/rule-engine/server/tests/sanity.test.ts (asserts true). EXACT TEST SCRIPT NAME later features key off: `npm run test` -> `vitest run`.

VERIFY (all green): `npm install` exit 0 (fresh, regenerated lockfile) -> `npm ci` exit 0 -> `npm run build` (strapi build) exit 0 -> `npm run test` exit 0 (1 passed). From worktree root `CGO_ENABLED=1 go build ./...` exit 0 and `git status --porcelain -- go.mod go.sum internal cmd` EMPTY. git add --dry-run cms/ stages 32 source files only — no node_modules/dist/build/.strapi/.env.
